court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Dr. Noorjehan Safia Niaz And 1 Anr vs State Of Maharashtra And Ors

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dr. Noorjehan Safia Niaz, Social Activist & Zakia Soman, Social Activist
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra Through Secretary, Minority Development Department & Haji Ali Dargah Trust

facts_of_case: Petitioners are social activists who claim that the State and the Haji Ali Dargah Trust have failed to protect their rights. They seek a direction from this Court to take steps to ensure their safety.

legal_principles.principle: The law in regard to the powers of the Court to issue a writ under Article 226 of the Constitution is well settled.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the said petition is clearly maintainable and that the law in pil.106.14.doc regard to the powers of the Court to issue a writ under Article 226 of the Constitution is well settled.
cited_cases: Shri Anandi Mukta Sadguru Shree Muktajee Vandasjiswami Suvarna Jayanti Mahotsav Smarak Trust and Ors. v. V. R. Rudani & Ors., (1989) AIR 1607 SC
Board of Control for Cricket v. Cricket Association of Bihar & Ors., (2016) SCC 709 SC

legal_principles.principle: The State shall not make any law which takes away or abridges the rights conferred by this Part and any law made in contravention of this clause shall, to the extent of the contravention, be void.
legal_principles.held: Article 13 of the Constitution gives recognition to customs/usages.

outcome.final_order: The petitioners' prayer for directions is allowed. The State and the Haji Ali Dargah Trust are directed to take steps to ensure the safety of the petitioners.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for cheque bounce
